name: Canvas LMS
hint: An access token from your Canvas profile: Account, Settings, New access token.

pick.name: list_courses
pick.says: Lists the courses the token’s user is enrolled in.

pick.name: list_course_users
pick.says: Lists the people in a course: students, teachers, TAs and observers.

pick.name: list_enrollments
pick.says: Lists a course’s enrollments, with each one’s grades.

pick.name: list_assignments
pick.says: Lists a course’s assignments with due dates and points.

pick.name: list_submissions
pick.says: Lists the submissions to one assignment, with scores and grades.

pick.name: list_student_submissions
pick.says: Lists submissions across assignments, for chosen students or all of them.

pick.name: list_missing_submissions
pick.says: Lists the past-due assignments a student has not submitted.

pick.name: list_conversations
pick.says: Lists the inbox conversations of the token’s user, newest first.

pick.name: update_assignment
pick.says: Edits an assignment. Body: {"assignment": {the fields to change}}.

pick.name: grade_submission
pick.says: Grades or comments on a student’s submission; the student sees both. Body: {"submission": {"posted_grade"}, "comment": {"text_comment"}}.

pick.name: enroll_user
pick.says: Enrolls a user in a course. Body: {"enrollment": {"user_id", "type": "StudentEnrollment", "enrollment_state": "active"}}.

pick.name: send_message
pick.says: Sends an inbox message. Body: {"recipients": [user ids], "subject", "body"}.
